reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 12 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 85 times in 100, by about 13; most games like this end between 201 and 249 total points.

analyst.text: Damian Lillard faces Milwaukee, where he tore his Achilles, while Deni Avdija (sore left foot) is out. The Bucks are 1-13 on a 10-game skid, Taylor Jenkins has used 150 different lineups, and Tyler Herro's second-half benching against Atlanta has added friction; they also play the night after Giannis's return game in Miami. The angle leans clearly towards Portland.
